name: Safari Adventure Golf, Hersham
summary: Play an outdoor 18-hole adventure-golf course at Hersham Golf Club, each hole part of a journey through the wildlife and landscapes of South America, Africa and Asia with interactive animal features. Works for a quick family activity or a friendly group competition.
reasonToVisit: An 18-hole safari-themed adventure golf course, good for families or groups
